title: Write the founder update
description: Draft an evidence-linked founder update and decision requests from the current synthetic operating snapshot.
purpose: Turn operating notes into an evidence-linked update and a clear decision request.
label: Operating notes for review
example: Synthetic example: A customer pilot is waiting on security review; the engineering owner is assigned but the client reviewer is unknown. A growth experiment competes for the same team this week. Bookings and pipeline are separate; no current totals or ROI baseline supplied. Ask the founder to resolve the resourcing tradeoff.

support.review: Do not invent metrics, board history or business results. Separate observed notes from proposed decisions.
support.deployments: Deployment status and ownership are only as supplied in the notes. Unknown reviewers and missing dates remain unknown.
